target_pattern: Use definite articles in Spanish where English often omits them: generic concepts, gustar categories, weekdays (except after ser), body parts/clothing with obvious ownership, titles when talking about someone, street names, and languages as concepts.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Dropping el/la/los/las because English often omits the article.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish article usage is pattern-based by context, not a direct English mirror.
target_pattern_formula: Generic concept: La salud es importante.
Gustar + category: Me gusta la musica. / Me gustan los perros.
Day (not after ser): Nos vemos el lunes. vs Hoy es lunes.
Body/clothing obvious owner: Me duele el brazo. / Ponte la chaqueta.
Talking about title/family member takes article; direct address drops it.
natural_examples: La educacion mejora la calidad de vida.
Me gusta la musica en vivo.
El ingeniero Soto llega a las nueve.

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each in Spanish using the target article pattern.
prompts_en: Education is expensive in many places.
Dr. Morales is in the office.
Doctor Morales, I need a signature.
Mathematics is difficult for many adults.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Me gusta la musica. -> change object to plural (los podcasts).
Base: Nos vemos el viernes. -> change day to martes.
Base: Hoy es viernes. -> change day to martes.
Base: Me duele la mano. -> change body part to plural (las piernas) and adjust verb.
Base: Ponte la camisa. -> change clothing to los zapatos.
Base: El doctor Perez llega temprano. -> rewrite as direct address to the doctor.
Base: La abuela esta afuera. -> rewrite as direct address to grandma.
Base: Vivo en la calle Luna. -> change to avenue Sol.
Base: El espanol es interesante. -> change language to ingles.
Base: Hablo espanol en la oficina. -> change language to frances.
Base: La economia crece rapido. -> make it negative.
Base: Las matematicas son dificiles. -> change subject to singular concept la historia and adjust agreement.
Base: Tenemos reunion el lunes. -> make question with ustedes.
Base: Hoy es lunes. -> make statement with ser for Wednesday.
Base: Me gustan los perros. -> change category to singular mass noun la musica.

prompts: Nature is beautiful. (La naturaleza es hermosa. vs Naturaleza es hermosa.)
I like music. (Me gusta la musica. vs Me gusta musica.)
We see each other Monday. (Nos vemos el lunes. vs Nos vemos lunes.)
Today is Monday. (Hoy es lunes. vs Hoy es el lunes.)
My elbow hurts. (Me duele el codo. vs Me duele mi codo.)
Put on your coat. (Ponte el abrigo. vs Ponte tu abrigo as neutral default.)
Dr. Ruiz is here. (El doctor Ruiz esta aqui. vs Doctor Ruiz esta aqui.)
Doctor Ruiz, I need help. (Doctor Ruiz, necesito ayuda. vs El doctor Ruiz, necesito ayuda.)
I live on River Street. (Vivo en la calle Rio. vs Vivo en calle Rio.)
Spanish is easy for her. (El espanol es facil para ella. vs Espanol es facil para ella.)

guided_personal_writing.instructions: Write one Spanish sentence for each specific meaning.
prompts: Write that health is your top priority this year.
Write that you like jazz music.
Write that you and your coworker meet on Tuesday mornings.
Write that today is Friday and you finish work early.
Write that your back hurts after a long meeting.
Write that you tell someone to put on their jacket because it is cold.
Write that Dr. Alvarez is leading the project.
Write that you directly ask Dr. Alvarez for five minutes of time.
Write that your grandmother is visiting this weekend.
Write that you directly ask your grandmother if she wants coffee.
Write that you live on Central Avenue.
Write that Spanish is important in your industry.
Write that you speak Spanish with clients every day.
Write that the economy is improving in your city.
Write that mathematics was difficult for you in school.

reverse_conceptual_expression.instructions: Write natural Spanish, not literal English.
prompts_en: My legs hurt after the flight.
Put on your shoes before leaving.
French is useful in this job.
I am learning French at night.

common_errors.why_it_happens: English generic nouns often omit the article.
Dropping article before categories with gustar.
Omitting article in street naming pattern.
Keeping article after verbs like hablar/saber/aprender.

common_errors.mistake: Me gusta escribir en el espanol.
common_errors.why_it_happens: Adding article after en for language medium.
Not treating matematicas as plural with article.

controlled_recombination: La educacion es cara en muchos lugares.
El doctor Morales esta en la oficina.
La abuela esta en la cocina.
El espanol es util para el trabajo.
Las matematicas son dificiles para muchos adultos.
